about: The data feed health thresholds. scripts/discovery_jobs_summary.py reads this file, and so do apps that rate the same data, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/rag-thresholds.md says how they fit together.

notes.pixel_period_hours: Hours of pixel traffic read for issue rates (get_pixel_health_status period_hours).
notes.pixel_amber_issue_pct: A pixel type with at least this percentage of its events flagged is amber.
notes.pixel_red_issue_pct: A core pixel type with at least this percentage of its events flagged is red.
notes.pixel_amber_volume_ratio: A pixel type whose count over pixel_period_hours is below this share of its 7-day daily average is amber.
notes.pixel_red_volume_ratio: A pixel type whose count over pixel_period_hours is below this share of its 7-day daily average is red.
notes.core_pixel_types: Pixel types every site should send. Only these go red on issue rate; add suggest-event and the widget-* events if the site uses autosuggest or recommendation widgets.
notes.jobs_limit: Catalog jobs read per catalog (search_discovery_catalog_jobs limit): the window the job rules look at.
notes.success_status: The job status that counts as a successful run.
notes.failed_statuses: Job statuses that count as a failed run.
notes.core_kinds: Job kinds that keep the product catalog current. The latest of these failing is red (other kinds amber), and their freshest success sets staleness.
notes.stale_hours: No success of any core kind for more than this many hours is red (also --stale-hours).
notes.aging_share: No success of any core kind for more than this share of stale_hours is amber.
notes.count_drop_amber_pct: A fall of at least this percentage in product_doc_count between a kind's two latest successful jobs is amber.
notes.count_drop_red_pct: A fall of at least this percentage in product_doc_count between a kind's two latest successful jobs is red.
